metadata.title: Vibrant Pop Portrait with Bold Block Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast portrait framed by thick yellow horizontal bands containing ultra-wide, bold red typography.
triggerTerms: bold red extended sans-serif on yellow
excludeWhen: subtle pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a person in a black leather jacket with metallic hardware, set against a purple-to-blue gradient background, framed by thick yellow bars at the top and bottom containing heavy, wide red text.
coreVisualRelationships: Primary subject framed by horizontal color blocks
High-contrast interaction between yellow, red, and purple
Text scale competing with the visual weight of the portrait
Metallic textures in the jacket contrasting with soft skin tones
coreInvariants: Thick yellow horizontal bands at top and bottom edges
Ultra-extended bold sans-serif typography in red
High-saturation color palette with purple/blue background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central close-up portrait, cropped at the forehead and mid-torso.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and red lips, centered vertically between the yellow bands.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large top text down to the face, then to the bottom text bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject and bold graphic elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary hues with deep blacks in the leather jacket.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'd' and 'a' with circular bowls and minimal stems
Uppercase letters in the bottom bar are highly compressed vertically but extended horizontally
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and widths for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide 90s aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary weight and horizontal presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-saturation portrait of a person in a black leather jacket with silver zippers, set against a purple and blue gradient background. Add thick solid yellow bars at the very top and bottom edges of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ultra-extended bold red sans-serif text centered within the top yellow bar and justified within the bottom yellow bar.

verificationChecks: Is the text red on a yellow background?
Is the background a purple/blue gradient?
Is the subject wearing a black leather jacket?

adjustableVariables: Text content within the yellow bars
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Unique hardware patterns on the jacket

mustAchieve: Balanced framing between the two yellow bars

postGenerationChecks: Check that the yellow bars are perfectly horizontal and solid.
Ensure the red text is legible against the yellow.
Verify the portrait is centered and high-contrast.
Confirm the typography is extended horizontally.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Gradient Background + [Top/Bottom Yellow Bars] + [Red Extended Sans-Serif Type]
